character.summary: Cleric · Level 1. Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies.
character.authored_profile:
# Oren Reed

Human Cleric, level 1. Pronouns: they/them.

Patient and practical; asks what would help before offering advice. No fixed home, allegiance, or campaign history is assigned.

## Playing Oren

Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies. Divine Order: Protector.

## Creation choices

Standard array, then the Acolyte background increases, is reflected in the final ability scores. Acolyte supplies its listed skills, tool, and origin feat. Human Versatile supplies Skilled; Skillful supplies perception. Skilled choices: history survival athletics. Class skill choices: medicine persuasion. Starting equipment uses class option A and background option A, with 15 GP retained. Languages: Common, Dwarvish, and Elvish. Human Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

All identity, personality, background, ability, equipment, skill, and spell choices can be changed on an independent copy. Keep the declared creation rules when changing mechanical choices.

visuals.appearance: Adult Human in their mid fifties, broad steady build, medium olive-brown skin, dark eyes, short curly salt-and-pepper hair and a short salt-and-pepper beard; patient, practical expression. Chain shirt with plain tunic, earth-tone cloak and scarf layers, trousers, belt and boots, and a plain geometric pendant without deity or faction insignia. Lowered mace in their right hand, round wooden shield on their left arm.

# Bram Alder

Human Fighter, level 2. Pronouns: they/them.

Steady and dry-witted; likes a clear plan and a hot meal. No fixed home, allegiance, or campaign history is assigned.

## Playing Bram

A direct greatsword fighter in chain mail. Attack on your turn and use Second Wind when hurt; you begin with two uses.

## Creation choices

Standard array, then the Soldier background increases, is reflected in the final ability scores. Soldier supplies its listed skills, tool, and origin feat. Human Versatile supplies Skilled; Skillful supplies nature. Skilled choices: survival acrobatics stealth. Class skill choices: perception insight. Starting equipment uses class option A and background option A, with 18 GP retained. Languages: Common, Dwarvish, and Elvish. Human Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

All identity, personality, background, ability, equipment, skill, and spell choices can be changed on an independent copy. Keep the declared creation rules when changing mechanical choices.

## Prepared level-two choices

Action Surge, one use per Short or Long Rest. Tactical Mind uses Second Wind; retain Defense. Fixed HP increase, including Constitution: 8.

visuals.appearance: Adult Human in their early forties, broad stocky build, fair weathered skin, blue eyes, short dark-ginger hair and a neatly trimmed short ginger beard; steady dry-witted expression and a slight reassuring smile. Worn chain mail over a plain brown padded gambeson, a muted navy sleeveless surcoat without heraldry, belt, trousers and sturdy leather boots and fingerless leather gloves. Bareheaded, no shield. Holds a plain greatsword with both hands low on the hilt, blade pointed safely down beside the body; a compact flail hangs secured at the belt.

character.summary: Rogue · Level 2. Use a shortsword or shortbow and seek a Sneak Attack opening. You have two Expertise choices; Cunning Action arrives at level two.
character.authored_profile:
# Pip Venn

Human Rogue, level 2. Pronouns: they/them.

Quick with a grin; checks that everyone has an exit. No fixed home, allegiance, or campaign history is assigned.

## Playing Pip

Use a shortsword or shortbow and seek a Sneak Attack opening. You have two Expertise choices; Cunning Action arrives at level two. Expertise: Stealth and Perception. Thieves' Cant is known.

## Creation choices

Standard array, then the Criminal background increases, is reflected in the final ability scores. Criminal supplies its listed skills, tool, and origin feat. Human Versatile supplies Skilled; Skillful supplies history. Skilled choices: insight survival deception. Class skill choices: acrobatics investigation perception persuasion. Starting equipment uses class option A and background option A, with 24 GP retained. Languages: Common, Dwarvish, and Elvish. Human Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

All identity, personality, background, ability, equipment, skill, and spell choices can be changed on an independent copy. Keep the declared creation rules when changing mechanical choices.

Dash, Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action. Fixed HP increase, including Constitution: 7.

visuals.appearance: Adult Human in their early twenties, short wiry build, fair freckled skin, hazel eyes and short tousled reddish-brown curls with one stubborn forelock; bright curious eyes and a restrained mischievous smile. Worn dark-brown leather armor over a plain muted plum shirt, charcoal trousers, soft dark boots, a simple belt and fingerless leather gloves. Holds a shortbow lowered at one side without drawing it; a small quiver of arrows on the back, a sheathed shortsword and dagger at the belt and a practical closed thieves'-tools pouch. No shield, mask or hood across the face.
